suggested_requirements.text: The system shall display a graphical user interface to the user.
The system shall be fully operable using a keyboard.
The system shall be fully operable using a mouse.
The system shall support multiple game types.
The system shall load additional games from an external source.
The system shall support multiple opening positions applicable to all games.
The system shall support two-player turn-based gaming.
The system shall provide a default random artificial intelligence.
The system shall allow the user to change the nature of players (human/AI) during a game.
The system shall load new artificial intelligence implementations from files.
The system shall define games separately from the software code.
The system shall search an external source for games on startup and load them.
The system shall end games based on a predefined condition.
The system shall save the current state of a game to a file.
The system shall load a saved game from a file.
The system shall provide an in-game help function containing solutions and hints.
The user interface shall follow common usability guidelines.
The user interface shall use one main window for game playing and dialog windows for settings.
The system shall function on a computer with a screen, keyboard, and/or mouse.
The system shall require a Java runtime environment (version 1.4 or later).
The system shall execute on machines fulfilling Java runtime environment requirements.
The artificial intelligence shall calculate the next move within 10 seconds.
The system shall require user confirmation before overwriting an existing file.
The system shall run on both Linux and Windows platforms.
